children: Western International Group, the holding company owning brands such as Nesto, Mark & Save, Geepas and Royalford, will rename Safeer Mall in Sharjah as Haya Mall when it reopens in the second half of this year.
The Group’s flagship store Mark & Save had acquired the property that housed Safeer Mall in April 2025 and the tenants had to vacate the premises.
Nawas Basheer KP, Director of Western International Group, had told a local media last year that “the new name of the mall is still under wraps and it will be revealed in due course.”
It is now learned that the new name will be Haya Mall.
Safeer Mall on Al Ittihad Road in Sharjah spans 50,639 square metres (approx. 545,000 sq. ft.) of leasable area featuring hypermarkets, entertainment centres, and various retail outlets.
According to Debangshu Adhikari, Senior Vice President, Mark & Save, the mall will be rebranded Haya Mall by the end of the year and will feature a hypermarket and multiple stores.”

“Mark & Save continues to expand its footprint across the UAE and GCC by combining value-driven pricing with an unmatched customer experience – that is gaining popularity among a growing number of consumers,” said Adhikari.

Mark & Save, one of the fastest growing hyperstore chains in the GCC, will is targeting a total of around 30 stores across the Gulf region. The chain has ambitious global plans, targeting 500 stores worldwide, including India, Southeast Asia, North America and Europe.

“With over 5,000 employees and counting, Mark & Save is not only creating memorable shopping experiences but also generating career opportunities and fostering growth in the retail sector,” Mohammed Fasil, Head of Operations at Mark & Save.

With 150 hypermarkets and supermarkets, the Western International Group operates one of the largest retail networks in the Middle East, with a vision to more than tripling the network to 500 superstores by 2030.
(Reporting by Bhaskar Raj; Editing by SA Kader)

title: Haya Mall coming up in place of Safeer Mall in Sharjah
